requirements.title: Dedicated contact workspace and persisted CRM actions
requirements.expected_result: Contact index opens a full workspace with URL/back-state persistence, mobile one-pane behavior, and persisted add/edit/tag/owner/lifecycle/follow-up/task/thread/family/archive actions.
requirements.implementation_status: Add Contact slice implemented, pushed, deployed to BNA and One Time, and live-smoked: Operations exposes ACTION-CRM-ADD-CONTACT, POST /api/bna/crm/contacts creates or updates one workspace-scoped first-party bna_contacts record, upserts workspace-scoped email/phone/WhatsApp identities, writes a local pipeline event, returns the stable bna_contacts:<id> contact key, and opens the saved contact workspace without external sends, access grants, imports, checkout, or automatic task creation. Archive Contact slice is implemented, pushed, deployed to BNA and One Time, and live-smoked: Operations exposes ACTION-CRM-ARCHIVE-CONTACT, the explicit click archives through the scoped CRM PATCH route with status=archived and create_follow_up_task=false, and deployed HTML readback confirms the action/function are present. Remaining actions include complete/reopen task and family/member linking.
requirements.next_action: Continue complete/reopen task and family/member linking.
